mapper.sql: select k.key_id, k.key_name, k.key_prefix, k.key_hash, k.user_id, u.user_name, k.allowed_paths, k.allowed_ips, k.expire_time, k.status, k.last_used_time, k.last_used_ip, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time, k.remark from sys_api_key k left join sys_user u on u.user_id = k.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_api_key (key_name, key_prefix, key_hash, user_id, allowed_paths, allowed_ips, expire_time, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values (#{keyName}, #{keyPrefix}, #{keyHash}, #{userId}, #{allowedPaths}, #{allowedIps}, #{expireTime}, '0', #{createBy}, localtimestamp, #{createBy}, localtimestamp, #{remark})
mapper.update: update sys_api_key set status = '1', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = localtimestamp where key_id = #{keyId} and status = '0'
